intro: Tajikistan has about 10 million people, one of the youngest populations in Asia.

chapters.title: People
text: Most people are Tajiks, with a large Uzbek minority. Tajik is written in Cyrillic letters. Most people are Sunni Muslim; Pamiris in the east are mainly Ismaili.
Over a million Tajiks work in Russia.

chapters.title: Dushanbe
text: The capital Dushanbe's name means 'Monday', after a Monday market.
